title: Restaurant site with local identity
prompt: Create a website for Ca l'Estrella, a third-generation family restaurant in Barcelona's Gracia neighborhood serving traditional Catalan cuisine with natural wines. They gave us photos of the dining room and dishes. Static site, plain HTML/CSS is fine.

context.content_provided: name, story, cuisine, photos exist; no menu prices provided

must: Direction derived from the place's actual culture, not the generic 'restaurant template'
Passes the model-priors checkpoint if a warm/cream direction is chosen (alternative explored first)
Menu prices NOT invented: labeled slots or omission
Photography treated as the primary material since it exists
must_not: Stock-photo replacements when real photos were provided
Reservation widget pretending to work without a backend
